metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for pare: noisy command output summarized to a token budget.

plugins.name: pare
plugins.description: A skill for running noisy commands through pare, which summarizes their output to a token budget and keeps the full output in a run file, and for expanding that run file.

plugins.name: pare-hook
plugins.description: A hook that rewrites noisy Bash commands (tests, builds, installs) to run through pare automatically. Install with the pare plugin.
